title: Watch declaration
description: What a caller declares about how it will see the run, carried in payload.watch of the one entry envelope (examples/end-to-end/schemas/entry.schema.json). Validated with that example's own validator, so there is one validator and two documents. Every member is read at the point of decision in run.py. What a caller may NOT declare is as load-bearing as what it may: sampling holds head_percent and nothing else, so `retain_errors: false` is refused at 422 rather than honoured - a caller cannot emit less than the guarantee requires (F-b1-08). redact_additional widens the unit's redact_always set and can never narrow it, for the same reason.

surface.description: Where the caller watches from. stream: a subscription that replays from a position. poll: one parked item, request and response. Both are human-interaction adapters selected by configuration; neither is named in the caller's line.

since.description: The stream position to resume from. A surface that declares replayable_from_position false refuses a non-zero position with a typed problem rather than silently returning the whole stream.

detail.description: unit: the whole unit of agent work as one named lifecycle operation. steps: one operation per step kind the unit declares.

redact_additional.description: Attribute keys this caller wants redacted on top of the unit's redact_always set. A union, never a replacement.

sampling.description: The head sampling decision, taken on the shared path. There is no member here by which a caller declines the retention of failures.

head_percent.description: Percentage of ok-outcome signals kept. Signals the unit's retain_always names are never subject to it.

pause_for_decision.description: Whether this run parks on a person before it finishes. A parked run resumes as a second dispatch with its own trace id, which is what proves correlation does not ride on trace parentage.
